member.name: P:OmicronLab.Bode.Engine.Interfaces.IBode100CommandDefinition.HardwareDelayIndex
member.summary: Gets the index of the hardware delay. If different between this index and the last index sent, a delay will be added before the actual measurement.
member.value: The index of the hardware delay.
member.remarks: The hardware delay index is (mainly) needed when attenuator shaping will be done, because when switching the 20dB channel attenuators (CH1 and CH2) during a sweep measurement the involved HF relays need some settling time. The settling time is 0.5 milliseconds per relay which sums up to 1.0 milliseconds because two relays are affected.
